name: savdoiq
description: SavdoIQ — Uzum Market sotuvchilari uchun analitika platformasi (Telegram login + Uzum API)

scripts.dev: npm run build:libs && concurrently -n api,bot,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:bot" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspace @savdoiq/api && npm run build --workspace @savdoiq/bot && npm run build --workspace @savdoiq/web
scripts.start: npm run build:libs && npm run start --workspace @savdoiq/api
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @savdoiq/shared && npm run build --workspace @savdoiq/db
